doc: 相似影评检索的人工检查用查询：5 条英文查询，覆盖 5 个主题（演技、剧情、节奏、配乐、台词幽默）。逐条对 Top-5 结果判相关/不相关写在本文件生成后的人工记录文件 experiments/retrieval_check.csv 中。
judging_rule: 相关性以「是否表达查询的主要观点」为依据，不能只看是否出现相同单词。例如查询关于演技时，只谈剧情但没提表演的影评判为不相关。

queries.text: The lead actor gave a powerful performance with great emotional depth.
queries.note: 关注表演质量与演员表现

queries.text: The story has an unexpected twist that keeps the audience guessing until the end.
The pacing is painfully slow and the film drags badly in the middle.
The soundtrack is beautiful and fits the mood of every scene perfectly.
The dialogue is witty and most of the jokes land surprisingly well.
queries.note: 关注台词写作与喜剧效果
